verdict.rationale: LocalAI advertises broad multimodal support ("Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D") and image generation, implying vision capability, but there is no specific documentation of vision-language model usage (e.g., passing images alongside text prompts, GPT-4V-style multimodal chat, or a concrete example model/config for VLMs). missing for 10: explicit vision-language model examples, API usage for image+text input, list of supported VLM backends (e.g., llava), independent corroboration.
